about: Product-specific VST3 component floats, measured from public host APIs. Values are stored VST3 plain values, which need not equal displayed physical units. Component and controller envelopes, unknown float slots and private tails are retained.

layers: stored float32 controls and opaque tail

parameters/Characteristic.about: VST3 parameter 0. Host display: 0 = Clean; 1 = Classic; 1 = Classic; 2 = Opto; 2 = Opto.

parameters/Knee Shape.about: VST3 parameter 3. Host display: 0 = Soft Knee; 0 = Soft Knee; 1 = Hard Knee; 1 = Hard Knee; 1 = Hard Knee.

parameters/Input Level.about: VST3 parameter 6. Host display: -1 = -INF dB; -0.5 = -18.00 dB; 0 = 0.00 dB; 0.5 = +18.00 dB; 1 = +36.00 dB.

parameters/Output Level.about: VST3 parameter 12. Host display: -1 = -INF dB; -0.5 = -18.00 dB; 0 = 0.00 dB; 0.5 = +18.00 dB; 1 = +36.00 dB.

parameters/Dry Level.about: VST3 parameter 14. Host display: -1 = -INF dB; -0.5 = -18.00 dB; 0 = 0.00 dB; 0.5 = +18.00 dB; 1 = +36.00 dB.

parameters/Auto Gain.about: VST3 parameter 16. Host display: 0 = Off; 0 = Off; 1 = On; 1 = On; 1 = On.

parameters/Auto Release.about: VST3 parameter 17. Host display: 0 = Off; 0 = Off; 1 = On; 1 = On; 1 = On.

parameters/Input signal.about: VST3 parameter 19. Host display: 0 = Normal input; 0 = Normal input; 1 = Side chain input; 1 = Side chain input; 1 = Side chain input.

parameters/Audition Side Chain.about: VST3 parameter 22. Host display: 0 = Off; 0 = Off; 1 = On; 1 = On; 1 = On.

parameters/Channel Processing.about: VST3 parameter 23. Host display: 0 = Left-Right; 0 = Left-Right; 1 = Mid-Side; 1 = Mid-Side; 1 = Mid-Side.

parameters/Receive Midi.about: VST3 parameter 24. Host display: 0 = Enabled; 0 = Enabled; 1 = Disabled; 1 = Disabled; 1 = Disabled.

parameters/Expert Mode.about: VST3 parameter 25. Host display: 0 = Off; 0 = Off; 1 = On; 1 = On; 1 = On.

parameters/Interface: Meter Scale.about: VST3 parameter 29. Host display: 0 = 48 dB; 1 = 24 dB; 2 = 16 dB; 2 = 16 dB; 3 = 8 dB.

parameters/Interface: Display Enabled.about: VST3 parameter 30. Host display: 0 = Off; 0 = Off; 1 = On; 1 = On; 1 = On.
